name: arms-only-rope-climb
instructions:
1. Jump and reach up as high as you can to start.
2. Support your bodyweight with one arm and pull yourself up with the other.
3. Repeat the process until you reach the top of the rope.
4. To descend, loosen your grip slightly and allow yourself to slide down the rope in a controlled fashion.
5. Once you reach the starting position, repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
